:::{#exm-additive-function}
#### An additive function, and one that is not

- $f(x) = 2x$ on $\reals$ is [additive](#def-additive-function).
  For $x, y \in \reals$:

  $$
  \begin{aligned}
  f(x + y) &= 2(x + y) \\
  &= 2x + 2y \\
  &= f(x) + f(y)
  \end{aligned}
  $$

- $g(x) = x + 1$ on $\reals$ is not additive,
  since $g(0 + 0) = 1$ but $g(0) + g(0) = 2$.

<!-- no-figure: the example checks an algebraic identity; it has no data or fitted model to plot -->

:::
